job: Replacing self-authored proxy completion checks with goal-grounded verification that runs the task's real target before the agent reports done.
outcome: A default-on completion-verification gate that executes the specified check (run the artifact, pass the test) before terminating.
motivation: Self-declared false success is a harness defect they own; trusted completion is a shippable, marketable differentiator versus rival frameworks.

task.what: wire run-the-real-target gating into the finish step
task.where: the agent loop's completion-judgment / termination path
task.why: stop agent-terminated self-stops against weaker targets
task.how: execute task-specified check before allowing done

job: Establishing research-artifact and environment-setup deployment as a standard scored axis in agent eval suites, beyond functional code generation.
outcome: Deployment / setup tasks adopted as a recurring evaluation axis (DeployBench-style) that scores whether agents stand up released code on fresh machines.
motivation: DeployBench exposed a measurement gap; making setup a standard axis pressures frameworks to fix completion judgment and validates their own benchmark.

task.what: add environment-setup deployment as eval axis
task.where: public agent evaluation suites and leaderboards
task.why: make deployment a tracked competitive metric

job: Building reproducible run-the-real-target execution scaffolding (containers, toolchains, GPU/CUDA) so completion checks can actually execute the artifact reliably.
outcome: Sandbox/runtime plumbing that lets the verification gate spin up the real target environment and confirm the specified check passes.
motivation: Goal-grounded gating is worthless without reliable execution substrate; integrators make the run-the-real-target check feasible and trustworthy.

task.what: provision real-target execution environments for checks
task.where: the harness sandbox / container runtime layer
task.why: enable reliable execution of the specified check
